svg.title: Pl Icp Steps
svg.desc: Series on point-to-plane ICP. Step 1: match source points P to target points Q and compute each target point's surface normal n_i and tangent line. Step 2: unlike point-to-point ICP, which penalises the full distance to q_i, the point-to-plane error (p_i - q_i) dot n_i only penalises the distance along the normal, so points can slide along the surface.
